title: WAT Merkle inclusion proof — wakir-inclusion-proof/v1 (STUB)
description: STUB — placeholder for the canonical wakir-inclusion-proof/v1 schema. TODO (ADR-0072 Phase 4, W4 cross-repo compatibility): merge the runtime-side draft authored in W2 (wakir-runtime `wirelang/schemas/wakir-inclusion-proof-v1.json`, emitted by `scripts/demo-proof.sh` step 4) into this file; wakir-protocol is the canonical home, wakir-runtime mirrors it, wakir-verify validates against it. Until the merge this stub only pins the field set that the proof-path test vectors under tests/fixtures/proof-path-vectors/ exercise: a self-contained SHA-256 sibling path from leaf_hash to merkle_root, Bitcoin duplicate-last convention, side L = sha256(sibling || current), side R = sha256(current || sibling). The stub deliberately omits additionalProperties=false and the optional hour/manifest_version/event_id constraints so that the W2 draft can land without a breaking bump.
